description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA models with varying SFT configurations. The horizontal axis represents the LLaMA models, labeled as LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a group of four bars, representing different SFT configurations: "no SFT" (blue), "+ SFT on D0" (yellow), "+ SFT on D0, D1" (purple), and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" (red). For LLaMA-2-7B, the bars have approximate values of 68, 69, 80, and 83, respectively. For LLaMA-2-13B, the values are around 70, 75, 85, and 82. For LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 78, 81, 84, and 83. The bars within each group are not sorted, but the groups are arranged in ascending order based on the model size. No bars are visually emphasized.
